messages:
Maya: kicking off blue->green lane evacuation for release v1.0.0 now. Plan: warmup new lane-b pods, then step traffic 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% (3 steps, ~6m per step). Session-affinity will be pinned to lane-b during warmup. Kill-switch = instant revert to lane-a. tagging: image=redwood-service:v1.0.0. @Sam @Kai pls watch LB knobs and sticky session behavior.
Sam: ack. confirm pin/tag names: image:redwood-service:v1.0.0 and router lane tag "lane-b"?
Maya: yes. sequence will be `route:set lane-b weight=5` then steps [25,50,100]. Rollback triggers: p95 > 3x baseline OR error-rate > 0.5% sustained 2m.
DeployBot: deploy-start id=ds-4600012345 target=lane-b steps=[5,25,50,100] initiating auto-stepper (safe-mode: true)
OpsBOT: preflight checks: healthchecks=✅, capacity=✅, cache-warm=✅, circuit-breakers=closed
Noah: watching grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/seg-release/canary (I'll post screenshots if anything pops)
DeployBot: applied weight 5% to lane-b (step 1). elapsed=00:02
Olivia: seeing a small p99 tail spike on lane-b (3 pods), p95 +10ms, p99 +140ms. looks intermittent
Kai: can we hold at 5% for another 6m? Suggest extra dwell to check memory/GC patterns before stepping
Maya: agreed — pausing the stepper now. pausing automated rollback disabled? (we still want kill-switch available)
DeployBot: stepper paused (operator: Maya). pending steps canceled until resume command.
Olivia: pulling logs from the 3 affected pods — one shows repeated minor GC churn, one has elevated heap growth. snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T15:04:11Z] java -Xmx6g | heap used: 5.7g -> growth +200MB/min
[2026-03-20T15:04:12Z] WARN  slow-alloc in allocator
```
Sam: hmm that host needs draining. If we drain that pod instance, lane-b will still have 2 healthy replicas, but warmup may lengthen. Alternatives: drain and re-warm, or full rollback.
Kai: leaning rollback. Draining could mask underlying regression and expose more clients. safer to revert to lane-a until we fix.
Maya: decision: trigger immediate rollback to lane-a. I'm invoking the kill-switch and marking this release blocked. @Noah please open an incident and attach logs.
DeployBot: initiating rollback id=rb-4600012345 -> setting lane-a weight=100, lane-b weight=0. executing switch now.
DeployBot: rollback complete. id=rb-4600012345 duration=12s status=success
OpsBOT: rollback validated: smoke tests green, routing stable. created postmortem skeleton PR: /incidents/PRD-4600012345
Noah: incident INC-2026-137 created and assigned. attached initial logs and timeline. starting root-cause triage now.
Maya: thanks. blocking v1.0.0. Drafting release note: "v1.0.0 release blocked due to memory/GC regression observed during canary; automated rollback applied. Investigating heap growth on new runtime flags." will add repro steps and metrics once RCA progresses
Olivia: :thumbsup: I'll snapshot the failing host (`instance-id i-0a1b2c3d4e`) and upload logs to s3://redwood-release-artifacts/4600012345/
Kai: we'll add an extra verification job (stress+heap-check) before next canary. Good catch everyone.
Maya: rename follow-ups: (1) increase warmup monitoring window, (2) add heap/regression test to preflight, (3) re-run canary after patch. posting notes to release channel and sending notify to beta customers.
Sam: noted. keeping the pinned image tag and marking v1.0.0 as 'blocked' in release tracker.
Noah: will keep updates in INC-2026-137. closing loop here; will ping when RCA has next steps.
